segments.text: Ok so, this is the tool-based state streaming page in the CopilotKit docs, for Deep Agents, the Python agent with React, and I have implemented this page in my project.
So this is my project, this is the exact code from the doc.
So what you see here is my copy with one change, umm, because the page's graph doesn't even load on the server.

After removing the checkpointer it loads, and the steps stream like the page says.
That's the one, please look into it.
